title: Will Saudi Arabia or Saudi Aramco confirm damage to the Rabigh refinery, a Yanbu Aramco facility or the East-West pipeline from a Houthi attack between 24 October and 15 November 2026?
criteria: YES if, between 24 Oct and 15 Nov 2026, the Saudi government (SPA, Civil Defense, Energy Ministry, coalition) or Saudi Aramco states that a Houthi missile/drone or its debris damaged, set on fire or interrupted operations at the Rabigh refinery, an Aramco facility in Yanbu, or the East-West crude pipeline or its pumping stations. Debris reported to fall 'near' a site without damage is NO. Houthi claims alone are NO. Source: SPA, Aramco, Reuters, AFP.

title: Will the civilian evacuation from Oleshky under the local ceasefire begin by 5 November 2026?
criteria: YES if by 5 Nov 2026 23:59 UTC Reuters, AP, AFP, the Russian or Ukrainian government, ICRC or the White House report that at least one convoy/group of civilians left Oleshky through the agreed passage. Humanitarian aid entering without anyone leaving is NO.

title: Will officials of the US, Russia and Ukraine meet in one trilateral session by 20 November 2026?
criteria: YES if by 20 Nov 2026 Reuters, AP or AFP report that officials of all three governments met in the same session (technical or political level, e.g. Abu Dhabi or Switzerland). Separate bilateral meetings in the same city do not count.

title: Will Iranian forces fire on a US Navy vessel, as acknowledged by CENTCOM, the Pentagon or Iran's armed forces, between 25 October and 30 November 2026?
criteria: YES if CENTCOM/the Pentagon or Iran's armed forces/IRGC state that Iranian forces fired missiles, drones, guns or boats' weapons at a US Navy ship between 25 Oct and 30 Nov 2026 (a hit is not required). Threats, warnings, harassment without fire are NO.

title: Will France declare a state of emergency (état d'urgence) by 30 November 2026?
criteria: YES if by 30 Nov 2026 the French Council of Ministers decrees a state of emergency under the 1955 law for all or part of metropolitan France. Local curfews or protest bans by prefects are NO.

title: Will US and Iranian government officials hold a publicly confirmed direct meeting by 30 November 2026?
criteria: YES if between 1 and 30 Nov 2026 officials of the US government and the Iranian government meet face to face (same room, mediators may be present), as confirmed by either government or by two major wire services. Indirect talks through Qatar, Oman or Pakistan, letters and phone calls do not count. Otherwise NO.

title: Will Russia and Ukraine both confirm an extension of the Kherson-region ceasefire beyond 1 November 2026?
criteria: YES if by 23:59 Kyiv time on 3 Nov 2026 official representatives of both Russia and Ukraine (president, government, MoD, ombudsman or negotiators) state that the ceasefire in force in the Kherson frontline region until the end of 1 Nov is extended or replaced by another ceasefire covering that region. Otherwise NO.

title: Will Russia and Ukraine both agree to a limited Black Sea ceasefire for shipping by 31 December 2026?
criteria: YES if by 31 Dec 2026 both the Russian and the Ukrainian governments publicly confirm an agreement to stop attacks on merchant shipping (grain and/or energy) in the Black Sea, whether bilateral or via Turkey, India, the US or the UN. Statements of interest or proposals do not count. Otherwise NO.

title: Will ICE Brent front-month futures settle above $120 on any day between 2 and 30 November 2026?
criteria: YES if the front-month ICE Brent futures settlement on any trading day from 2 to 30 Nov 2026 is above $120.00 per barrel, as reported by Reuters, CNBC or ICE. Otherwise NO.

title: Will Poland's Constitutional Tribunal president Bogdan Swieczkowski be back in office by 30 November 2026?
criteria: YES if by 30 Nov 2026 the one-month suspension of the Tribunal's president is lifted or ends and he performs his duties in the Tribunal building, as reported by PAP, Reuters or AFP. Otherwise NO.

reason: resolution ambiguous: the suspension's legality is itself contested, so 'back in office' has no neutral test
